scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && node packages/remcli-cli/bin/remcli.mjs setup
scripts.build: npm -w remcli-web run build && npm -w remcli run build
scripts.start: npm run build && node packages/remcli-cli/bin/remcli.mjs daemon stop; node packages/remcli-cli/bin/remcli.mjs daemon start-sync
scripts.start:tunnel: npm run build && node packages/remcli-cli/bin/remcli.mjs daemon stop; node packages/remcli-cli/bin/remcli.mjs daemon start-sync --tunnel
scripts.typecheck: npm -w remcli-web run typecheck && npm -w remcli run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w remcli-web run test && npm -w remcli run test
